high.title: SBV: LDR Ratio of BIDV, VietinBank, Vietcombank, Agribank Approaching Maximum Threshold
high.summary: The State Bank of Vietnam has released a draft amendment to Circular 22/2019 regarding safety limits and ratios for bank operations. A key change is shifting from the "loan-to-deposit ratio" (LDR) to "credit-to-funding ratio" (CDR). The new metric includes total outstanding credit and total mobilized funding, expanding beyond just loans and deposits to include corporate bond investments and off-balance sheet commitments on the credit side, plus non-deposit funding sources. Regarding State Treasury deposits, the draft adjusts how these are calculated in bank funding sources. This regulatory change is significant for FX and bond markets as it affects how major state-owned banks (Big 4) manage their balance sheets and liquidity. With these banks' ratios already near maximum thresholds, tighter regulations could impact their lending capacity and potentially affect VND liquidity in the interbank market. Watch for implementation timeline and any transitional arrangements that might influence short-term funding costs.

high.title: Not Big 4 Group, This is the Bank That Attracted the Most Customer Deposits in Q1/2026
high.summary: HDBank emerged as the top deposit mobilizer in Q1/2026, adding over 60.8 trillion VND in customer deposits (+11%), reaching 621.5 trillion VND total. This outpaced even major state-owned banks in absolute terms. The overall banking system saw modest deposit growth of only 0.6% (75.98 trillion VND increase) across 27 listed banks, marking the slowest quarterly growth in years. HDBank's aggressive deposit growth amid system-wide funding constraints signals strong competitive positioning and potentially higher deposit rates offered to customers. For VND traders, this indicates potential pressure on interbank rates as banks compete for scarce deposits. The divergent performance between HDBank and the broader system suggests deposit migration toward more aggressive pricing, which could influence the SBV's policy stance on interest rates and banking sector liquidity management.

medium.title: SJC Gold Price, Ring Gold Evening 11/5: Continue to Decline, Losing Over 2 Million VND/Tael
medium.summary: Domestic gold prices fell sharply on May 11 evening, with SJC gold trading at 162.2-165.2 million VND/tael, down 2.3 million VND from morning. International gold dropped below $4,700/oz to $4,676/oz amid USD strength and oil recovery.

medium.title: One Vietnamese Bank Has Terminated Operations of 126 Transaction Offices
medium.summary: VietinBank closed 18 transaction offices in Q1/2026, bringing total closures to 126 offices over the past year while maintaining 157 branches. Despite branch optimization, Q1 pre-tax profit surged 63% to over 11.1 trillion VND with improved cost-income ratio at 24.9%.

medium.title: Securities Company Lowers VN-Index Forecast for 2026
medium.summary: VNDirect revised down its VN-Index year-end target to 1,967 points (+10.2% vs 2025) from previous 2,100 points, citing external uncertainties. The firm maintains positive outlook based on FTSE Russell upgrade to Secondary Emerging Market status in September 2026 and expected 14% earnings growth.

medium.title: VN-Index Approaches Historical Peak, Securities Firm Warns of "Green Shell, Red Core" Scenario
medium.summary: VN-Index is approaching historical resistance around 1,910 points. VNDirect notes that despite strong index gains, liquidity hasn't broken out and market breadth remains narrow, concentrated in large-cap stocks. P/E ratio at 13.8x remains below 10-year average of 15.4x.

medium.title: Securities Company with Trillion VND Capital Heavily Fined
medium.summary: Bao Minh Securities (BMS) fined 280 million VND total: 187.5 million for failing to segregate customer assets from company assets, and 92.5 million for inadequate information disclosure regarding transactions above 10% of total assets.
